newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hargraves quarterly gold output up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hargraves quarterly gold output up.

text.p: Hargraves Resources NL said on Friday it produced 12,059 ounces of gold in the December quarter, up from 9,091 in the previous quarter.
Cash operating costs over the same period improved to an average A$365.58 an ounce from A$430.00, the company said.
Hargraves, which is mining the Brown's Creek deposit in central New South Wales, also produced 282 tonnes of contained copper in the quarter, up from 226 in the previous period.
Taking copper credits into account, gold operating costs were A$287.45 and A$361.00 an ounce respectively, it said.
